title_o: Children’s Drawings About “Radiation”—Before and After Fukushima

replications.journal: Multidisciplinary Journal for Education, Social and Technological Sciences
replications.quote: In this study the children barely associate the concept of “radiation” with the Fukushima Nuclear Disaster. Moreover, a number of differences could be realized when compared to the reference study. For instance, significantly more students drew cell phones and computer monitors in the current study.
